subject: Initial values for range and model fitting

messages.author: 21e2646f0cc9f243
messages.subject: Initial values for range and model fitting
parts:
Hello, I have two questions:

1. I used an empirical Variogram to estimate the value of the range, (the point where the variogram starts to level off) and also the variance (Total variance minus the nugget from the variogram) and used this values in the SPDE model

```
spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh = mesh,
  alpha = 2,
  constr = TRUE,
  prior.range = c(200, .5),   # P(range < 200) = .5
  prior.sigma = c(0.23, .5)   # P(sigma > 0.23) = .5
)
```
What do you think about this?

2. When fitting the model itself, I get the warnings:

*** warning *** iterative process seems to diverge, 'vb.correction' is aborted
*** Please (re-)consider your model, priors, confounding, etc.
I have no missing values in my covariates. What could be causing this. 

Here is the code I used for the model:

```
mod <- inla(
  formula,
  family = "binomial",
  Ntrials = numtrials,
  data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),
  control.family = control.family(link = 'logit'),
  control.predictor = list(
    compute = TRUE,
    link = 1,
    A = inla.stack.A(stk.full)
  ),
  control.compute = list(config = TRUE, return.marginals.predictor = TRUE),
  control.inla = list(tolerance = 1e-7), 
  num.threads = 7,
  verbose = F
)
```

Please make sure you're using R-4.4 and the most recent R-INLA version. This is
not an error but a warning, but it would be great for further code development
to be able to reproduce this and for me to check details of what is happening.
would you be able to share to the code/data?

Best
HAvard
